bug_info.bug_desc: The branch unit raises an instruction address misaligned exception for any branch or jump with a misaligned target address, regardless of whether a conditional branch is actually taken. According to the RISC-V specification, this exception should only be generated for taken branches or unconditional jumps. The condition `if (branch_valid_i && target_address[0] != 1'b0)` does not check the branch comparison result or instruction type, causing spurious exceptions on not-taken conditional branches.
bug_info.fix_hint: Modify the exception condition in the `exception_handling` block to also require that the instruction is either an unconditional jump (JAL, JALR) or a conditional branch that is taken (branch_comp_res_i == 1). This ensures the exception is only raised when the branch is actually taken, aligning with the RISC-V specification.
